retrySpec.description: Specifies various parameters for automatic retry that occurs in upsert due to retryable errors.

keyFieldsOnly.description: If true will discard all non key fields in {@Link CloudResourceKeyFields}

validateId.description: Indicate whether the operation should validate that input has full C3 ID.

reset.description: If true will discard all non reference fields before populating defaults.

templateBindings.description: Optional overrides for Cloud Template / Config bind variables

autoSeq.description:
Indicates whether to auto populate the sequence number for {@link CloudResource}s with unpopulated
sequence number field. This can be combined with use of autoIncrementSeq.
If only autoSeq is set, auto populate seq without increment.
e.g., AwsEmr.fromId('local-env-emr').withDefaults(CloudResourceOperationSpec.make({autoSeq: true})) will give you
an instance of {@link AwsEmr} with id of 'local-env-emr-{seq}' where the seq is the last sequence number from
available emrs. If autoIncrementSeq is also set then the seq on the id is the next available sequence number.

autoIncrementSeq.description:
Indicates whether to auto populate and select next available sequence number for {@link CloudResource}s with
unpopulated sequence number field.

retryOnAnyError.description: If set then action will be retried on any error not just retryable errors.

failIfMissing.description:
Typically cloud apis return `null` if underlying resource is missing. If this option is set it will throw
`NotFound` exception.

doNotMerge.description: Indicate whether this cloudResource should be merged with existing one

waitForDestroy.description: Indicate whether the destroyResource operation should return until the resource is destroyed.

waitForCreate.description: Indicate whether the upsertResource operation should return until the resource is actually created.

waitForOk.description: Indicate whether the upsertResource operation should return until the resource is fully available.

doNotUseCloudRefResourceNameForCloudId.description:
When building out a cloud resource, based on its CloudRef, we either use the id as-is, or try extracting a cloud-id from
the resourceName, or just use the resourceName as-is. This flag controls whether you want to opt-out of extracting cloud-id from the  resourceName

failOnConflict.description: Indicate whether the upsertResource operation should fail if there is a conflict between the resource being upserted and the resource already present.

localDryRun.description:
If true, upsert operations will not be executed against the cloud provider.
The final output to be sent to the cloud provider will instead be returned back to the user.

skipTagging.description: Indicate whether the re-tagging is performed on Cloud Resource upserts.

ignoreExisting.description: Indicate whether cloud framework should perform the check for an existing cloud resource before an upsert operation.

env.description: C3 Environment; e.g. dev, stage, prod.

pod.description: C3 pod name; e.g. enel, bge, c3, srv.

package.description:
C3 server package to deploy e.g. c3-server-development-7.9.2.11-1.x86_64.rpm. If not specified, the package of the host
cluster will be deployed on the new cluster

credentials.description:
Optional azure credentials used to plant in the configuration files of the newly created cluster. If not specified,
the credentials from the host cluster bring up the new environment will be used

numMasters.description: The number of masters to start up in the cluster.

masterInstanceType.description: The instance type of the masters.

numWorkers.description: The number of workers to start up in the cluster.

workerInstanceType.description: The instance type of the workers.

presets.description:
Values to use instead of starting components. Useful if some or all of the cluster is already configured.
Setting the `package` indicates that the RPM has already been uploaded to the cluster's store, so skip
the download from artifacts and upload to Azure storage.
